policies.name: Institution members can read billable events
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tenant_identity_map tim
  WHERE ((tim.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (tim.institution_id = billable_events.institution_id))))

policies.name: bursars_select_own
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = bursars.profile_id) AND (p.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

policies.name: cbt_answers_teacher_select

  WHERE ((a.id = cbt_answers.attempt_id) AND cbt_teacher_can_access_exam(a.exam_id))))

policies.name: cbt_options_teacher_select

policies.name: cbt_snapshots_student_insert
policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM cbt_sessions s
  WHERE ((s.id = cbt_session_snapshots.session_id) AND cbt_is_student(s.student_id))))

policies.name: cbt_snapshots_student_select

policies.name: cbt_sessions_candidate_insert
policies.with_check:
(cbt_candidate_is_owner(candidate_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM cbt_attempts a
  WHERE ((a.id = cbt_sessions.attempt_id) AND (a.exam_id = cbt_sessions.exam_id) AND (a.candidate_id = cbt_sessions.candidate_id)))))

  WHERE ((v.question_item_id = v.id) AND (v.review_status = 'approved'::text))))

policies.name: school applicant creates own pending request
policies.with_check: ((submitted_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (status = 'pending'::text) AND (reviewed_by IS NULL) AND (reviewed_at IS NULL) AND (institution_id IS NULL) AND (school_id IS NULL))

policies.name: school applicant updates own unreviewed request
policies.using: ((submitted_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (status = 'pending'::text) AND (reviewed_by IS NULL))
policies.with_check: ((submitted_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'withdrawn'::text])) AND (reviewed_by IS NULL) AND (reviewed_at IS NULL) AND (institution_id IS NULL) AND (school_id IS NULL))
